G4400.et: middle voice from (4253) and a derivative of (5495)
G4400.def: middle voice from «4253» and a derivative of «5495»; to handle for oneself in advance, i.e. (figuratively) to purpose:--choose, make.

G4401.def: from «4253» and «5500»; to elect in advance:--choose before.

G4402.def: from «4253» and «5525»; before the dance; Prochorus, a Christian:--Prochorus.

G4403.def: feminine of prumnus (hindmost); the stern of a ship:--hinder part, stern.

G4404.def: adverb from «4253»; at dawn; by implication, the day-break watch:--early (in the morning), (in the) morning.

G4405.et: feminine of a derivative of (4404) as noun
G4405.def: feminine of a derivative of «4404» as noun; day-dawn:--early, morning.

G4406.def: from «4404»; dawning, i.e. (by analogy) autumnal (showering, the first of the rainy season):--early.

G4407.def: from «4404»; pertaining to the dawn, i.e. matutinal:--morning.

G4408.et: feminine of a presumed derivative of (4253) as noun
G4408.def: feminine of a presumed derivative of «4253» as noun; the prow, i.e. forward part of a vessel:--forepart(-ship).

G4409.def: from «4413»; to be first (in rank or influence):--have the preeminence.

G4410.def: from «4413» and «2515»; a sitting first (in the front row), i.e. preeminence in council:--chief (highest, uppermost) seat.

G4411.def: from «4413» and «2828»; a reclining first (in the place of honor) at the dinner-bed, i.e. preeminence at meals:--chief (highest, uppermost) room.

G4412.et: neuter of (4413) as adverb (with or without (3588))
G4412.def: neuter of «4413» as adverb (with or without «3588»); firstly (in time, place, order, or importance):--before, at the beginning, chiefly (at, at the) first (of all).

G4413.def: contracted superlative of «4253»; foremost (in time, place, order or importance):--before, beginning, best, chief(-est), first (of all), former.

G4414.def: from «4413» and «2476»; one standing first in the ranks, i.e. a captain (champion):--ringleader.

G4416.def: from «4413» and the alternate of «5088»; first-born (usually as noun, literally or figuratively):--firstbegotten(-born).

G4417.def: a form of «4098»; to trip, i.e. (figuratively) to err, sin, fail (of salvation):--fall, offend, stumble.

G4419.def: neuter of a presumed derivative of «4420»; a winglet, i.e. (figuratively) extremity (top corner):--pinnacle.

G4420.et: from a derivative of (4072) (meaning a feather)
G4420.def: from a derivative of «4072» (meaning a feather); a wing:--wing.

G4422.et: probably akin to the alternate of (4098) (through the idea of causing to fall) or to (4072) (through that of causing to fly away)
G4422.def: probably akin to the alternate of «4098» (through the idea of causing to fall) or to «4072» (through that of causing to fly away); to scare:--frighten.

G4424.et: from Ptolemaios (Ptolemy, after whom it was named)
G4424.def: from Ptolemaios (Ptolemy, after whom it was named); Ptolemais, a place in Palestine:--Ptolemais.

G4425.def: from «4429»; a winnowing-fork (as scattering like spittle):--fan.

G4426.et: from a presumed derivative of (4429) (and thus akin to (4422))
G4426.def: from a presumed derivative of «4429» (and thus akin to «4422»); to frighten:--terrify.

G4428.et: probably akin to petannumi (to spread, and thus apparently allied to (4072) through the idea of expansion, and to (4429) through that of flattening, cf (3961))
G4428.def: probably akin to petannumi (to spread; and thus apparently allied to «4072» through the idea of expansion, and to 4429 through that of flattening; compare «3961»); to fold, i.e. furl a scroll:--close.

G4430.def: from the alternate of «4098»; a ruin, i.e. (specially), lifeless body (corpse, carrion):--dead body, carcase, corpse.

G4431.def: from the alternate of «4098»; a crash, i.e. downfall (literally or figuratively):--fall.

G4432.def: from «4433»; beggary, i.e. indigence (literally or figuratively):--poverty.

G4433.def: from «4434»; to be a beggar, i.e. (by implication) to become indigent (figuratively):--become poor.

G4434.et: from ptosso {to crouch, akin to (4422) and the alternate of (4098))
G4434.def: from ptosso (to crouch); akin to «4422» and the alternate of «4098»); a beggar (as cringing), i.e. pauper (strictly denoting absolute or public mendicancy, although also used in a qualified or relative sense; whereas «3993» properly means only straitened circumstances in private), literally (often as noun) or figuratively (distressed):--beggar(-ly), poor.

G4435.et: from a primary pux (the fist as a weapon)
G4435.def: from a primary pux (the fist as a weapon); the clenched hand, i.e. (only in dative case as adverb) with the fist (hard scrubbing):--oft.

G4436.et: from Putho (the name of the region where Delphi, the seat of the famous oracle, was located)
G4436.def: from Putho (the name of the region where Delphi, the seat of the famous oracle, was located); a Python, i.e. (by analogy, with the supposed diviner there) inspiration (soothsaying):-- divination.

G4437.def: from the same as «4635»; clasped (thick), i.e. (figuratively) frequent; neuter plural (as adverb) frequently:--often(-er).

G4438.et: from a derivative of the same as (4435)
G4438.def: from a derivative of the same as «4435»; to box (with the fist), i.e. contend (as a boxer) at the games (figuratively):--fight.

G4439.def: apparently a primary word; a gate, i.e. the leaf or wing of a folding entrance (literally or figuratively):--gate.

G4440.def: from «4439»; a gate-way, door-way of a building or city; by implication, a portal or vestibule:--gate, porch.

G4441.et: middle voice prolonged from a primary putho (which occurs only as an alternate in certain tenses)
G4441.def: middle voice prolonged from a primary putho (which occurs only as an alternate in certain tenses); to question, i.e. ascertain by inquiry (as a matter of information merely; and thus differing from «2065», which properly means a request as a favor; and from «154», which is strictly a demand for something due; as well as from «2212», which implies a search for something hidden; and from «1189», which involves the idea of urgent need); by implication, to learn (by casual intelligence):--ask, demand, enquire, understand.

G4442.def: a primary word; "fire" (literally or figuratively, specially, lightning):--fiery, fire.

G4444.def: apparently a primary word ("burgh"); a tower or castle:--tower.

G4445.def: from «4443»; to be on fire, i.e. (specially), to have a fever:--be sick of a fever.

G4446.def: from «4445»; inflamed, i.e. (by implication) feverish (as noun, fever):--fever.

G4447.def: from «4443»; fiery, i.e. (by implication) flaming:--of fire.

G4448.def: from «4442»; to kindle, i.e. (passively) to be ignited, glow (literally), be refined (by implication), or (figuratively) to be inflamed (with anger, grief, lust):--burn, fiery, be on fire, try.

G4451.def: from «4448»; ignition, i.e. (specially), smelting (figuratively, conflagration, calamity as a test):--burning, trial.

G4452.pos:
1. yet, even
  2. used only in compound with words 3369, 3380, 3764, 3768, 4455
G4452.et: another form of the base of (4458)
G4452.def: another form of the base of «4458»; an enclitic particle of indefiniteness; yet, even; used only in the comparative. See «3369», «3380», «3764», «3768», «4455».

G4453.et: probably ultimately from pelomai (to be busy, to trade)
G4453.def: probably ultimately from pelomai (to be busy, to trade); to barter (as a pedlar), i.e. to sell:--sell, whatever is sold.

G4454.def: apparently a primary word; a "foal" or "filly", i.e. (specially), a young ass:--colt.

G4455.def: from «4452» and «4218»; at any time, i.e. (with negative particle) at no time:--at any time, + never (...to any man), + yet, never man.

G4456.et: apparently from poros (a kind of stone)
G4456.def: apparently from poros (a kind of stone); to petrify, i.e. (figuratively) to indurate (render stupid or callous):-- blind, harden.

G4458.pos: 1. by any means, at all, perhaps
G4458.et: adverb from the base of (4225), an enclitic particle of indefiniteness of manner
G4458.def: adverb from the base of «4225»; an enclitic particle of indefiniteness of manner; somehow or anyhow; used only in composition:--haply, by any (some) means, perhaps. See «1513», «3381». Compare «4459».

G4459.et: adverb from the base of (4226), an interrogative particle of manner
G4459.def: adverb from the base of «4226»; an interrogative particle of manner; in what way? (sometimes the question is indirect, how?); also as exclamation, how much!:--how, after (by) what manner (means), that. (Occasionally unexpressed in English).

G4460.def: of Hebrew origin («7343»); Raab (i.e. Rachab), a Canaanitess:--Rahab. See also «04477».

G4461.et: of Hebrew origin (07227) with pronominal suffix
G4461.def: of Hebrew origin (7227 with pronominal suffix); my master, i.e Rabbi, as an official title of honor:--Master, Rabbi.

G4463.def: from «4464»; to strike with a stick, i.e. bastinado:--beat (with rods).

G4464.def: from the base of «4474»; a stick or wand (as a cudgel, a cane or a baton of royalty):--rod, sceptre, staff.

G4465.def: from «4464» and «2192»; a rod- (the Latin fasces) holder, i.e. a Roman lictor (constable or executioner):--serjeant.

G4466.def: of Hebrew origin («07466»); Ragau (i.e. Reu), a patriarch:--Ragau.

G4467.et: from a comparative of rhaidios (easy, i.e. reckless) and (2041)
G4467.def: from a comparative of rhaidios (easy, i.e. reckless) and «2041»; easy-going behavior, i.e. (by extension) a crime:--lewdness.

G4468.def: from the same as «4467»; recklessness, i.e. (by extension) malignity:--mischief.

G4469.def: of Chaldee origin (compare «07386»); O empty one, i.e. thou worthless (as a term of utter vilification):--Raca.

G4470.def: from «4486»; a "rag," i.e. piece of cloth:--cloth.

G4471.def: of Hebrew origin («07414»); Rama (i.e. Ramah), a place in Palestine:--Rama.

G4472.et: from a derivative of rhaino (to sprinkle)
G4472.def: from a derivative of rhaino (to sprinkle); to render besprinkled, i.e. asperse (ceremonially or figuratively):-- sprinkle.

G4474.et: from a derivative of a primary rhepo (to let fall, "rap")
G4474.def: from a derivative of a primary rhepo (to let fall, "rap"); to slap:--smite (with the palm of the hand). Compare «5180».

G4475.def: from «4474»; a slap:--(+ strike with the) palm of the hand, smite with the hand.

G4476.def: from a primary rhapto (to sew; perhaps rather akin to the base of «4474» through the idea of puncturing); a needle:-- needle.

G4477.def: from the same as «4460»; Rachab, a Canaanitess:--Rachab.

G4478.def: of Hebrew origin («07354»); Rachel, the wife of Jacob:--Rachel.

G4479.def: of Hebrew origin («07259»); Rebecca (i.e. Ribkah), the wife of Isaac:--Rebecca.

G4480.def: of Latin origin; a rheda, i.e. four-wheeled carriage (wagon for riding):--chariot.

G4481.et: by incorrect transliteration for a word of Hebrew origin (03594)
G4481.def: by incorrect transliteration for a word of Hebrew origin («03594»); Remphan (i.e. Kijun), an Egyptian idol:--Remphan.

G4482.def: a primary verb; for some tenses of which a prolonged form rheuo hryoo'-o is used to flow ("run"; as water):--flow.

G4483.def: perhaps akin (or identical) with «4482» (through the idea of pouring forth); to utter, i.e. speak or say:--command, make, say, speak (of). Compare «3004».

G4484.def: of Latin origin; Rhegium, a place in Italy:--Rhegium.

G4485.def: from «4486»; something torn, i.e. a fragment (by implication and abstractly, a fall):--ruin.

G4486.et: both prolonged forms of rheko (which appears only in certain forms, and is itself probably a strengthened form of agnumi [see in (2608)])
G4486.def: both prolonged forms of rheko (which appears only in certain forms, and is itself probably a strengthened form of agnumi (see in «2608»)) to "break," "wreck" or "crack", i.e. (especially) to sunder (by separation of the parts; «2608» being its intensive (with the preposition in composition), and «2352» a shattering to minute fragments; but not a reduction to the constituent particles, like «3089») or disrupt, lacerate; by implication, to convulse (with spasms); figuratively, to give vent to joyful emotions:--break (forth), burst, rend, tear.

G4487.def: from «4483»; an utterance (individually, collectively or specially),; by implication, a matter or topic (especially of narration, command or dispute); with a negative naught whatever:--+ evil, + nothing, saying, word.

G4488.def: probably of Hebrew origin (apparently for «07509»); Resa (i.e. Rephajah), an Israelite:--Rhesa.

G4489.def: from «4483»; a speaker, i.e. (by implication) a forensic advocate:--orator.

G4490.def: adverb from a derivative of «4483»; out-spokenly, i.e. distinctly:--expressly.

G4491.def: apparently a primary word; a "root" (literally or figuratively):--root.

G4493.def: from «4496»; a jerk (of the eye, i.e. (by analogy) an instant):--twinkling.

G4494.et: from a derivative of (4496) (meaning a fan or bellows)
G4494.def: from a derivative of «4496» (meaning a fan or bellows); to breeze up, i.e. (by analogy) to agitate (into waves):--toss.

G4495.def: from a derivative of «4496»; to toss up:--cast off.

G4496.et: a primary verb (perhaps rather akin to the base of (4474), through the idea of sudden motion)
G4496.def: a primary verb (perhaps rather akin to the base of «4474», through the idea of sudden motion); to fling (properly, with a quick toss, thus differing from «906», which denotes a deliberate hurl; and from teino (see in «1614»), which indicates an extended projection); by qualification, to deposit (as if a load); by extension, to disperse:--cast (down, out), scatter abroad, throw.

G4497.def: of Hebrew origin («07346»); Roboam (i.e. Rechobam), an Israelite:--Roboam.

G4498.def: probably for rhode (a rose); Rode, a servant girl:--Rhoda.

G4499.def: probably from rhodon (a rose); Rhodus, an island of the Mediterranean:--Rhodes.
